options.text: What can I do in the city?

steps.player: What can I do in the city?

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: Why don't you visit the market? I hear there is quite a craze for surface foods at the moment, so you might be able to sell something there.

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik apparently found ways to cross over their heads!

options.text: Why did you decide to open the city?

steps.speaker: Ur-tag
steps.text: For trade, and for fostering goodwill between races! I am sure that it will benefit both our races.

steps.npc: It's funny... whenever we dwarves have ventured onto the surface, we've found ourselves at war with the goblins there.
But now we meet these goblins underground, and they're no threat at all. Maybe this will herald a change in our relations with the surface goblins as well.
I can't stand these goblins sometimes! I come up with suggestions to make their city more efficient, and they just say it would spoil their precious way of life!
Trade with the goblins is going well at the moment. It's a pity they don't seem as interested in our beer as in your food, though!
Thank you again for helping us complete the train link. Further delays would have cost the Consortium a lot of money.
Oh, and I hear you saved someone's life as well. Well done on that count too.
I miss Keldagrim. This city is all very well, but no one makes an underground city like the dwarves!
